units.source_text: 源氏内大臣的车子远远地来了。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, came riding from afar in his carriage.

units.source_text: 明石姬一见，更加伤心，竟不能抬起眼来眺望这意中人的面影。

en.t: At the sight of him, Lady Akashi grew still more heartbroken, and could not even raise her eyes to gaze upon the face of the man she loved.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝依照河原左大臣的先例，特赐源氏内大臣随身童子一队。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku, following the precedent of the Kawara Minister of the Left, specially granted Genji, the Inner Minister, a retinue of attendant boys.

units.source_text: 这十个童子装束非常华丽，发作童装，左右耳旁结成两环。

en.t: These ten boys were dressed with extraordinary splendor, their hair arranged in the style of children, tied into two loops beside their ears.

units.source_text: 结发的紫色带子浓淡配合，非常优美。

en.t: The purple ribbons binding their hair were beautifully matched in light and dark shades.

units.source_text: 身材一样高低，相貌都很漂亮，姿态十分可爱。

en.t: They were all of the same height, all had handsome faces, and their bearing was exceedingly charming.

units.source_text: 葵姬所生小公子夕雾，由大队人员簇拥而来，随马的童子个个一样打扮，服装显然与众不同。

en.t: The young lord Yugiri, born to Lady Aoi, arrived surrounded by a large company; the boys attending his horse were all dressed alike, and their clothing was plainly of a special rank.

units.source_text: 明石姬看见夕雾如此高贵尊严，想起自己的女儿藐不足数，不胜悲伤。

en.t: When Lady Akashi saw Yugiri looking so noble and dignified, she thought of how insignificant her own daughter seemed, and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 便向着住吉神社合掌礼拜，为女儿祝福。

en.t: She then faced Sumiyoshi Shrine, joined her palms in prayer, and prayed for her daughter's good fortune.
